basic_info.description: Nestled at the top of Forest Hill, this delightful 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers warmth, character, and a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers. Built in 1955 and lovingly maintained, the home features original hardwood floors, new kitchen countertops, and a large deck in the backyard.  The upper level offers a bright and functional layout with a comfortable living room, dining area, two bedrooms, and a full bath. Downstairs, you'll find a private third bedroom and an additional bathroomperfect for guests, a home office, or multi-generational living.  Step outside to a serene, fenced backyardideal for gardening, entertaining, or a play space for children.  Just a short walk to Golden Gate Heights Park, Hawk Hill, and Herbert Hoover Middle School, this home is perfectly positioned for both convenience and peaceful living.
